contribution.procedure: Director contribution-tagging procedure, adopted for Project Uppercut by Director override 2026-08-02 (see docs/decisions/0006).

title: Fighter
description: Authored fighter definition. Enforces PROJECT_RULES.md Rule 10 (attribute economy) structurally where JSON Schema can; the remaining Rule 10 laws are enforced by tools/uppercut_validate/attributes.py because they are cross-field.

fixture_kind.description: Generic sandbox fixtures are balance instruments, not roster characters (Decision 0005).

ambidextrous.description: Rule 15: a small, exclusive set. Ambidexterity removes stance-familiarity penalty only; it grants no universal superiority.

stance_familiarity_penalties.description: Rule 15: authored per fighter, applied when operating outside the stated stance. Required unless ambidextrous. Values are tuning hypotheses (Rule 18).

attributes.description: Rule 10: internal attributes range -100..+100, zero is balance. Keys must exist in data/attribute_families.json.

compensations.description: Rule 10 requires compensating relationships to be EXPLICIT DATA. Each entry declares which positive attribute pays for which severe negative. See docs/phase0/open_questions.md OQ-1 for exclusive-vs-shared binding.

severe_negative_consequences.description: Rule 10: severe negatives must cause visible gameplay consequences. One entry required per attribute below -40.

traits.description: Rule 11: a complete fighter should have at least fifteen meaningful traits. Generic test fixtures are exempt (enforced in the validator by fixture_kind).

specials.description: Rule 11: exactly two counterable Specials for a complete fighter.

ultimate.description: Rule 11: exactly one powerful but counterable Ultimate. Never an automatic match end.

full_crowd_trait.description: Rule 12: one distinctive Full-Crowd Trait. At a full Crowd Bar the fighter chooses Ultimate OR Full-Crowd Trait; one completed bar cannot activate both.

vulnerabilities.description: Rule 11: visible strengths and vulnerabilities preserving matchup counterplay.

contribution.description: Identifying contribution tag (Director procedure). Permitted on data files because JSON cannot carry comments.
